properties.description: Both response valid signals clear after a synchronous reset edge. Pre-edge reset observations are not prematurely cleared.
Every presented data byte, including blocked presentations, matches the accepted ordered input prefix or justified completed-frame zero padding.
Every presented data beat has last exactly at the minimum-padded or maximum-truncated frame boundary; incomplete input prefixes remain supported.
Every presented header describes the next completed accepted input frame with correct original length, adjusted length, padding and truncation, independently of data-channel consumption.
Each independently blocked response retains valid and its entire payload across edges, unless a synchronous reset cancels it.

After 128 consecutive idle-source, reset-low, both-ready cycles, all tracked input and response obligations are drained, including incomplete accepted frames. Scoreboard checks are bounded to 62 outstanding frames per channel and reset starts a fresh epoch.
